title: YourMondayMotivator: Why I hate the weekend ...
html: This morning I woke up realising why I hate weekends and it wasn't thewhy I had been thinking it was for years - I like working. That is true. However, this morning I realised it was because weekends areunstructured. Week days I know exactly what I am doing, where I am going, and what I am eating. In the weekends it's generally a bit of a lottery. I don't know what I'm doing, where I'm going or what I'm eating. In fact the eating part is the part that gave me this realisation. I'm very disciplined around food and the weekend is a complete nightmare for me sometimes because dinner organisation goes out the window on Friday night. Thinking about this is easy. Putting it into practice is going to be a bit of a logistical nightmare for my wife. There will have to be compromises. But maybe just knowing this now will make the weekend easier. Or do I need to get a hobby? Be great to get your feedback on this . Have a great week and enjoy the structure of it. My best. GlennThis weeks image
